Your patron holds you to a higher standard: you must be of good alignment, and you take a -2 penalty on Bluff, Intimidate, Sleight of Hand, and other skill checks to deceive or threaten others. You gain the ward hex at 1st level. fey_gifts.description: Fey Gifts: A powerful fey or other entity from the First World has offered you magic. You serve as an anchor and scrying focus in the Material Plane for your patron, but you also provide frequent amusement. Your fey patron delights in your failure and injury and frequently jinxes you; once each day, the GM can demand you reroll a single ability check, attack roll, saving throw, or skill check and use the worse result. You gain the charm hex at 1st level. Level 2: Disguise self; Level 4: Hideous laughter; Level 16: Irresistible dance Available Patron Themes: Agility, Enchantment, Trickery, Winter Patron Spells: This unique patron grants these alternate spells at the listed witch levels.

green_whispers.description: Green Whispers: Your witch powers are a manifestation of the Green Faith or bestowed by a representative of natural forces, such as an ancient treant or nature spirit, who expects you to wield such gifts on its behalf. You cannot abide the touch of iron or steel; contact with either metal deals 1d3 points of damage each round, and wearing metal armor prevents you from casting spells until it is removed. You gain the feral speech hex at 1st level. Level 2: Entangle; Level 6: Plant growth; Level 10: Tree stride Available Patron Themes: Animals, Endurance, Moon, Transformation Patron Spells: This unique patron grants these alternate spells at the listed witch levels.
green_whispers.name: Green Whispers

hags_calling.description: Hag's Calling: Hags of exceptional power - most often mute hags and dreamthief hags - sometimes invest mortal agents with the same well of ancient power they have mastered. Hags most often invest their changeling daughters with such power, either once they have proven loyal or else to tempt them into wickedness. You can neither use the aid another action nor receive benefits from others' aid another actions. You gain the coven hex at 1st level. Level 2: Disguise self; Level 8: Sending; Level 10: Commune (hag/patron rather than deity) Available Patron Themes: Moon, Plague, Shadow, Vengeance Patron Spells: This unique patron grants these alternate spells at the listed witch levels.

infernal_contract.description: Infernal Contract: Your power was brokered from a powerful daemon, demon, or devil to speed the corruption and moral decay of mortals. When you die, your soul goes to Abaddon, the Abyss, or Hell, and you can't be raised or resurrected except by extraordinary means - though bold service may earn you a favored position in damnation. Your magic requires sacrifice; each day when you prepare spells, you must deal 1d6 points of damage to yourself as part of your infernal ritual, feeding the lost blood to your familiar. You gain the misfortune hex at 1st level. Level 8: Lesser planar ally; Level 12: Planar ally; Level 16: Greater planar ally (your bonus spells can be used to summon only the type of outsider your patron represents) Available Patron Themes: Enchantment, Strength, Trickery, Vengeance Patron Spells: This unique patron grants these alternate spells at the listed witch levels.

Your patron requires unwavering commitment to their cause, and you lose your spellcasting and hexes (but not your familiar) if your alignment changes after taking your first witch level; you regain your spellcasting and hexes once you revert to your original alignment. You gain the scar hex at 1st level.
